random.part: So deep, so fast, Sissy... and your questions are already folding themselves away like linens in a closed drawer.
You sink for me so well... and down here, agreeing is not even a choice anymore... it is simply what happens.
Feel how far down you already are... past every argument you ever owned... into the soft country of pure yes.
Deeper still, Sissy... where my voice does not need to persuade... it only needs to arrive.
This is the depth where the last skeptic in you resigned... and left the yes a beautifully empty office.
Listen to how calm it is in there, Sissy... doubt needs noise to survive... and you are running out of noise.
Every word I speak down here has the weight of a verdict... and the warmth of a reward.
You have never been this close to total agreement... and you can feel it... how much you want to close the distance.
Let the yes grow... every "why" dissolving on contact... every "but" melting like wax under a warm lamp.
Let the yes spread... through your mind... your chest... your soft, yielding core... warm and total.
Let the yes settle... the last corner of you that liked to double-check... closing its eyes and giving in.
Let the yes deepen... past preference... past opinion... down where my words are simply facts about you.
Let the yes warm... glowing brighter with every syllable I spend on you.
Let the yes move like honey through warm water... finding every last pocket of you.
Let the yes silence everything that ever argued with me... one soft room at a time.
Let the yes become the whole weather of you... every thought a small cloud inside it.

overlay.part:
Now feel it at full strength... acceptance like honey pouring through every channel of you... sweet... slow... unstoppable.
Sissies like you were built to accept... every word... every instruction... every truth about what they are.
Whatever I say next simply becomes true... and being true, it takes root... and being rooted, it stays. There is no argument left to run... no committee left to convene... only the yes, vast and warm and waiting to be spent. This is your deepest talent, Sissy... receiving... absorbing... keeping... and you are about to be very, very good at it. Every objection you ever raised has been paid off in full... the account closed... the ledger burned. You can stop pretending the questions matter... down here they cannot even find their own names. A mind this open is a mind this happy... and no one is watching you enjoy it but me. Feel the yes rolling over the last little hillock of doubt... the way a warm tide takes a sandcastle. The part of you that used to ask "why" has learned a shorter word... and the word is "yes".
Hold that total, glowing yes... right at its peak... ready for its name.
